mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", sequence_id AS "sequenceId", provider_id AS "providerId", sequence_key AS "sequenceKey", display_name AS "displayName", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.effect_sequences WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND sequence_id = #{sequenceId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.effect_sequences (game_id, sequence_id, provider_id, sequence_key, display_name, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{sequenceId}, #{providerId}, #{sequenceKey}, #{displayName}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, sequence_id) DO UPDATE SET provider_id = EXCLUDED.provider_id, sequence_key = EXCLUDED.sequence_key, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", sequence_id AS "sequenceId", provider_id AS "providerId", sequence_key AS "sequenceKey", display_name AS "displayName", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.effect_sequences WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, sequence_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.effect_sequences_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, sequence_id, provider_id, sequence_key, display_name ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, sequence_id, provider_id, sequence_key, display_name FROM public.effect_sequences WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, sequence_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, provider_id = EXCLUDED.provider_id, sequence_key = EXCLUDED.sequence_key, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name
